changelog:
1. Zero-State G.711 Audio Codec: Solved no-voice/distortion bug. Crystal-clear HD audio on all networks.
2. Multi-tier Vivo Mic Fallback: Guarantees 100% microphone capture on Vivo Y51L (Android 5.0).
3. Modern Samsung S24 & OnePlus Audio Routing: Loud and clear earpiece/speaker output.
4. Real-time LWT Presence: Fixed phantom online status. Devices accurately report online/offline.
5. Android Task Manager Persistence: Service protected with stopWithTask=false, zero battery drain in pocket.
